request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER

layers.text: Change only the rider's clothes and the blanket: the red bandana becomes a brown leather cap; take off the red tunic so his chest, belly and arms are bare olive green skin with one brown leather strap across the chest; the red saddle blanket becomes stitched brown hide. All leather is dull mid-brown, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows; no red and no orange left. Keep the grey wolf, the goblin's face, ears, spear, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
